# Gemma Grounded Health v1.1.0

<!-- generated by `ggh release-notes` from the results bundle, the Hub release plan and docs/known-issues.md; do not edit -->

> **Research only, not medical advice.** The model summarises what a study abstract says. It is not guidance for anyone's diagnosis or treatment.

The second tagged release (OWNER D-75). It ships the v3b fine-tune (`gemma-e2b-grounded-v3b-q4`): v2's Gemma 4 E2B LoRA adapter trained further by GRPO reinforcement learning on v2's training prompts and gold labels, answering a research question only from the abstract it is given, as JSON with a yes, no or maybe label, a short answer and the numbers of the sentences it relied on. Weights: [Hugging Face model](https://huggingface.co/biplob123/gemma-4-e2b-grounded-health) (merged safetensors and the LoRA adapter) and [Hugging Face GGUF](https://huggingface.co/biplob123/gemma-4-e2b-grounded-health-GGUF) (Q4_K_M, the registered and benchmarked file, and Q8_0, recommended where it fits), Hub tag `v3b.0.0`. Reproduce it from a fresh clone with [Reproduce from scratch](https://github.com/biplob819/gemma-grounded-health/blob/main/docs/reproduce.md).

### Pre-registered comparisons

From `configs/eval_plan_v3b.yaml` (final). Differences with 95% paired bootstrap intervals on shared cases; a gap is separated only under the plan's Holm-corrected rule, otherwise it is a tie (Tech Spec §7.4). Every model on both sides was scored the same way: run `main_v3b`, claims extracted by `gpt-6-luna`, judged by `gpt-6.1-sol` alone. The plan has a single primary test, so Holm leaves its p-value unchanged.

| Comparison | Outcome | Judge | Difference | p | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| gemma-e2b-grounded-v3b-q4 minus gemma-e2b-grounded-v2-q4 | headline | gpt-6.1-sol | 0.174 [0.147, 0.202] | <0.001 | gemma-e2b-grounded-v3b-q4 better |

Caveats: gpt-6.1-sol: calibrated, held-out kappa 0.598 [0.468, 0.711] on 231 pubmedqa claims, lower bound at least 0.4 (OWNER D-59): agreement with a Claude Opus 5.5 reference labeller (a model's labels, not a human expert's; OWNER D-60). Gemma-family check (40 claims from main_v2): agreement 0.950, kappa 0.893 [0.722, 1.000]; EvalKit's own run summaries keep its per-run stamp (OWNER D-59); B5 and B8 are a blind review by Claude Opus 5.5, not the owner (OWNER D-61). Earlier releases' published numbers stand under their own plans and are not compared here; they are on the model card and in the bundle.

Both GGUFs ship. Q4_K_M is the registered, benchmarked file; Q8_0 (4737.4 MB against 3269.1 MB) is recommended where it fits: it agrees with the merged bf16 weights on the label for 0.990 of dev prompts against Q4_K_M's 0.924 (a parity miss disclosed under OWNER D-73); its headline in the same run is 0.541 [0.510, 0.572] (`gpt-6.1-sol`), exploratory and outside the pre-registered test (OWNER D-73).

## Known limits

From [Known issues](https://github.com/biplob819/gemma-grounded-health/blob/main/docs/known-issues.md) (the release path's open, disclosed and owner-waived rows; the model card's Limits section has the rest).

- v3b restates cited result sentences closely: 0.191 of its answers are copies (similarity 0.9 or more to one cited sentence) against 0.107 for v2, and 0.407 are near-copies (0.7 or more) against 0.238. Among answers that are not copies its headline is 0.461 against 0.283 for v2 and 0.306 for base. The copy measure misses verbatim cut-down extractions, so some copies count as non-copies (V3.6, V3.7).
- 2 of v3b's cited sentences at Q4_K_M went unjudged in the scoring run (`docs/results/main_v3b/result.json`).
- Q4_K_M's label agreement with the merged weights is 0.924, under the export check's bar of 0.950 (OWNER D-73); see Parity on the model card.
- `gemma-e2b-grounded-v3b-q8` is v3b at Q8_0, scored in the same run as an exploratory model outside the pre-registered test (OWNER D-73): no v3b claim rests on it.
- v3b was built after v1's and v2's test results were seen (D-43); its plan (`configs/eval_plan_v3b.yaml`) was hashed before any v3b training step.
